 Updated: 1:52 PM EDT Oct 29, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Alex Suckow Digital Media Manager LOUISVILLE, Ky. — With early voting underway across the country, many ballots have already been cast ahead of Election Day, including in Indiana and Kentucky.
 So, how many votes have actually been cast?
 Advertisement The Get the Facts Data Team is tracking early and mail-in ballots ahead of Election Day, Nov. 3. The data comes from the University of Florida Election Lab .
